description.value: D² Tea Lab is a specialty craft tea café in Burnaby built around the '3/7' ratio — three parts milk to seven parts tea — developed through what the owners describe as years of scientific research and sensory analysis. The menu centers on craft milk teas, pure teas, and snowy lattes, sourced from premium leaves chosen for quality and sustainability. The lab-themed branding and data-driven flavour philosophy give it a distinctive character among BC's bubble tea scene.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 20m; rack (2 spaces) at 54m; rack at 76m. Total: 4 spaces.
